detail.longDescription: Hey HN! Kupe started as me building my dream Kubernetes platform. It's got abit out of hand and turned into multi-tenant SaaS poc. It's Kubernetes with GitOps, networking, logs, metrics and Grafana all wired up. I've been building out all of the core functionality and adding everything I would want in a mature k8s platform. The main idea is to have everything needed to turn a cluster into a platform ready right from cluster creation. It's suppose to be simple to get up and running but flexible enough to allow users to implement thier preferred workflows. It's built on the shoulders of some really awesome open source giants. It's been fun getting all the these pieces working together, new clusters auto register with Argo with a healthy amount of monitoring ready to go. It's in alpha and completely free to use. There are some rough edges, but hopefully no dragons, if you have any issues at all, please shout and i'll do my very best to fix asap! It's exciting to finally share it and see what people think. Would love feedback, especially on the opinions baked in. Hopefully they're useful defaults, but interested to hear where they get in your way or if anything feels missing. https://kupe.cloud/signup Thanks for taking a look! Billy
